svg.title: IMG-06-02 Clearance: cross-section and swept path in a curve
svg.desc: Owner 2026-11-15: 500 mm each side of the swept path, 2100 mm high. Curve: swept-path engine (swept-path-evot), 90 deg R1000 right turn, measured 2-trolley train, AGV body 574 wide, axle 380 from rear (CAD). AGV drawn from the CAD top view.
svg.text: Clearance: 500 mm each side of the swept path, clear to 2100 mm. Keep free
Swept path: area covered by the vehicle and two trolleys. The trolleys cut inside curves
Cross-section schematic. Curve simulated: vehicle with two trolleys, smallest tape radius R 1000. Dimensions in mm.
